description: FoRDy: Rocking Shallow Foundation Performance in Dynamic Experiments is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Bruce Kutter, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). In recent years, numerous centrifuge and 1g shake-table experiments have demonstrated that rocking shallow foundations can be designed as an effective component of a seismically resilient bridge or building structure. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.13019/3rqyd929. Keywords: Nonlinear soil-structure interaction; Foundation rocking; Shallow foundations; Bridge piers; Shear walls; Physical modeling; Centrifuge modeling; Shaking table testing; Seismic testing; Dynamic response. Published 2023-11-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
